nodes.summary: React函数组件，接收bidPrice和askPrice属性，计算价差并格式化显示，无效价格时展示'--'占位。

nodes.name: store.ts
nodes.summary: 报单模块Zustand状态管理，封装报单提交、止损单提交、撤单等操作，包含合约选择、表单管理和完整的客户端校验逻辑。
nodes.languageNotes: 使用Zustand的create工厂创建store，内联定义所有action方法；提交前执行多重校验（价格、数量、保护价、涨跌停、套利合约格式等）。

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: 交易数据格式化工具函数集，提供价格、数量、时间、涨跌、涨跌幅的统一格式化输出，所有函数均处理无效值并返回'--'占位符。

nodes.name: formatPrice
nodes.summary: 格式化价格，保留2位小数，对无效值（null、非正数、CTP无效价格1.7976931348623157e+308）返回'--'。

nodes.name: formatVolume
nodes.summary: 格式化数量，添加千分位分隔符（en-US locale），null值返回'--'。

nodes.name: formatTime
nodes.summary: 格式化时间字符串，空值返回'--'，否则原样返回HH:MM:SS格式。

nodes.name: formatChange
nodes.summary: 格式化涨跌值，正数带+号、负数带-号，保留2位小数，null/NaN返回'--'。

nodes.name: formatPercent
nodes.summary: 格式化涨跌幅百分比，正数带+号、负数带-号，末尾追加%符号，保留2位小数，null/NaN返回'--'。

nodes.name: validators.ts
nodes.summary: 报单参数校验工具函数集，提供价格、数量、合约代码、数量上限和套利合约的校验，所有函数返回null（通过）或错误消息字符串。

nodes.name: validatePrice
nodes.summary: 校验价格有效性：不能是NaN且必须大于0，返回null或错误消息。

nodes.name: validateVolume
nodes.summary: 校验数量有效性：不能是NaN、必须大于0且必须为整数。

nodes.name: validateInstrumentId
nodes.summary: 校验合约代码非空，去除首尾空白后检查是否为空字符串。

nodes.name: validateVolumeWithLimit
nodes.summary: 校验数量上限：市价单期货≤60手/期权≤30手，限价/套利期货≤500手/期权≤100手，先调用validateVolume做基础校验再检查上限。

nodes.name: validateArbitrage
nodes.summary: 校验套利合约两腿：两腿均不能为空且不能相同。

nodes.name: order.py
nodes.summary: 订单数据模型文件，定义 OrderRequest（报单请求）和 OrderReturn（报单回报）两个 Pydantic BaseModel，使用 camelCase 命名与 CTP 字符值常量，用于前后端数据的校验与序列化。
nodes.languageNotes: 使用 Pydantic BaseModel 定义数据模型，字段采用 camelCase 命名与 CTP 原生 PascalCase 字段对应，方向、开平、价格类型等枚举使用 CTP char 字符串值（如 "0"=买、"1"=卖）。

nodes.name: OrderRequest
nodes.summary: 报单请求 Pydantic 模型，定义提交报单所需的 9 个字段：合约代码、买卖方向、开平标志、价格类型、限价、数量、时效条件、成交量条件、投机保值标志，所有枚举字段使用 CTP char 字符串默认值。

nodes.name: OrderReturn
nodes.summary: CTP 报单回报 Pydantic 模型，包含 17 个字段用于接收柜台回执：报单编号、系统编号、状态、方向、成交数量、交易所代码、交易日、前置/会话 ID 等，覆盖 CTP OrderField 核心字段。

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: 可拖拽调整面板大小的手柄组件，使用React forwardRef包装，支持水平和垂直方向，渲染拖拽指示器。

nodes.name: panelStorage.ts
nodes.summary: 面板布局尺寸 localStorage 持久化工具，提供 savePanelSizes 和 loadPanelSizes 两个函数，含错误保护。

nodes.name: savePanelSizes
nodes.summary: 将面板布局尺寸序列化为 JSON 存入 localStorage，使用 simnow-panel-sizes- 前缀键名，静默处理存储异常。

nodes.name: loadPanelSizes
nodes.summary: 从 localStorage 读取并反序列化面板布局尺寸，键不存在或解析失败时返回 null。

nodes.name: manager.py
nodes.summary: WebSocket 连接管理器，支持多端点连接池（market/order/position/stop/system）、广播消息、心跳检测和自动清理断开连接。

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: 连接状态指示器组件，显示行情(MD)和交易(TD)双通道连接状态，含中文标签、CSS状态类、悬停提示和重连计数。

nodes.name: ContractSearch
nodes.summary: Searchable contract dropdown component with keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape). Filters contracts by instrumentID, instrumentName, and productName. Renders a text input with a floating results list. Supports active item highlighting and scroll-into-view.

nodes.name: ContractSearchProps
nodes.summary: Props interface for ContractSearch: contracts (ContractInfo array) and optional onSelect callback receiving instrumentID.

nodes.name: useMarketWs.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite for useMarketWs hook. Tests WS connection to ws/market endpoint, market_data batch update to store, ignoring non-market_data messages, reconnect support, K-line data appending with appendKline, timestamp rounding by period, 100ms batch merging of multiple messages, and instruments_refreshed toast/reload behavior.

nodes.name: useMarketWs
nodes.summary: WebSocket market data hook using singleton WSManager pattern. Connects to ws/market endpoint, buffers incoming market_data messages, and flushes every 100ms as batch updates to the market store. Converts snapshots to K-line data points with period-based timestamp rounding (handles night session tradingDay edge case). Tracks cumulative volume and computes delta volume per tick. Also handles instruments_refreshed messages (toast + reload contracts list). Uses useReconnect for auto-reconnect with exponential backoff.

nodes.name: PERIOD_MS
nodes.summary: Map of K-line period strings to milliseconds: 1m=60000, 5m=300000, 15m=900000, 30m=1800000, 1h=3600000.

nodes.name: snapshotToKline
nodes.summary: Converts a MarketSnapshot to a KLineData point. Constructs full UTC timestamp from actionDay + updateTime (with night session tradingDay-1 correction for h>=20), floors to period boundary, and returns single-price OHLC (high/low computed dynamically by appendKline).

nodes.name: resetGlobalWs
nodes.summary: Resets the global singleton WSManager instance. Used only in tests to ensure clean state between test cases.

nodes.name: KLineChart.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Test suite for KLineChart component. Mocks echarts and ResizeObserver. Tests rendering of chart container, period selector buttons (1m/5m/15m/30m/1h), empty state, instrument name display, active period highlighting, echarts initialization, candlestick OHLC data format, chart disposal on unmount, MA lines (MA5/MA10/MA20), volume bar series, VOL-MA5 line, and dual-grid layout (main + sub).

nodes.name: KLineChart
nodes.summary: K-line chart component built on ECharts. Renders a candlestick chart with two grids (main price chart + sub indicator chart). Supports main indicators (MA with MA5/10/20, Bollinger Bands) and sub indicators (Volume with VOL-MA5, MACD, KDJ, RSI). Includes period selector buttons (1m/5m/15m/30m/1h), indicator dropdowns, data zoom with cross-grid axis pointer linkage, and zoom state preservation on data updates.

nodes.name: KLineChartProps
nodes.summary: Props interface for KLineChart: instrument (string), klineData (KLineData[]), period (string), optional onPeriodChange callback.

nodes.name: calcMA
nodes.summary: Calculates Simple Moving Average for K-line close prices over a given period. Returns array of (number|null) where first period-1 values are null.

nodes.name: calcEMA
nodes.summary: Calculates Exponential Moving Average. Initializes first period-1 values with SMA, then applies EMA formula with k=2/(period+1).

nodes.name: calcMACD
nodes.summary: Calculates MACD indicator: DIF (EMA12-EMA26), DEA (EMA9 of DIF), MACD histogram ((DIF-DEA)*2). Returns object with dif, dea, macd arrays.

nodes.name: buildOption
nodes.summary: Builds the complete ECharts option object from K-line data. Constructs candlestick series, main indicator series (MA or BOLL), sub indicator series (Volume/MACD/KDJ/RSI), dual-grid layout with linked axis pointers, and dataZoom configuration.

nodes.name: indicators
nodes.summary: Technical indicator calculation functions: calcVolumeMA, calcBoll (Bollinger Bands), calcKDJ, calcRSI. Used by KLineChart for sub-chart indicators.

nodes.name: MarketPanel.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Test suite for MarketPanel component. Mocks ResizeObserver, react-resizable-panels, api, useMarketWs, usePointOrder, InstrumentSearchModal, echarts. Tests panel title rendering, loadSubscribedContracts on startup, WS connection initialization, DepthQuote for selected instrument, resize handle, preset/user tabs, search/unsubscribe buttons, search modal open/close, and unsubscribe button state.

nodes.name: MarketPanel
nodes.summary: Main market panel component orchestrating the market data view. Manages preset/user contract tabs, resizable split layout (MarketTable + DepthQuote/SpreadDisplay), WebSocket connection initialization, contract search/subscribe/unsubscribe/favorite actions, point-and-click order integration, and T-type options view toggle. Loads subscribed contracts on mount and subscribes via API.

nodes.name: MarketTable
nodes.summary: High-performance market data table using @visactor/vtable with virtual scrolling. Displays contract info (instrumentID, productName, exchangeID, expireDate) and live market data (lastPrice, change, changePercent, bidPrice1, askPrice1, volume, openInterest). Features price change coloring (red up/green down), CTP invalid price handling, row click/double-click callbacks, and automatic selected row highlighting with scroll-into-view only when off-screen.

nodes.name: MarketTableProps
nodes.summary: Props interface for MarketTable: contracts (ContractInfo[]), snapshots (Map<string, MarketSnapshot>), optional selectedInstrument, onRowClick, onRowDoubleClick callbacks.

nodes.name: buildRecord
nodes.summary: Builds a table record from a ContractInfo and optional MarketSnapshot. Computes change and changePercent from lastPrice vs preSettlementPrice (fallback to preClosePrice). Handles CTP invalid prices (DBL_MAX sentinel) and missing data with placeholder '--'.

nodes.name: store.test.ts (market)
nodes.summary: Test suite for market Zustand store. Tests selectedInstrument get/set/clear, snapshots Map updates (single, replace, multiple instruments), batchUpdate merging, subscribeInstruments API call (no immediate getSnapshots), klineData Map management (set, replace, append with same/new timestamp, delta volume handling), and currentPeriod management.

nodes.name: useMarketStore
nodes.summary: Zustand store for market data state. Manages: selectedInstrument (string|null), snapshots (Map<string, MarketSnapshot> with single/batch update), subscribeInstruments (calls API, relies on WS for data), klineData (Map<string, KLineData[]> with set/append operations), and currentPeriod (default '5m'). appendKline handles same-period update (high/low from close, volume accumulation via delta) and new-period append (volume=delta, keeps last 200 bars).

nodes.name: api.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for the API service layer. Tests axios instance configuration (baseURL, timeout, headers), getInstruments (keyword search), subscribeMarket, getSnapshots (single/multiple/all), getKlineData (period params), submitOrder (CTP field conversion), cancelOrder, refreshInstruments, cancelAllOrders (partial failure), reversePosition (full params, 501 handling), lockPosition, getPositions, getOrders, getOptionChains (underlying/expire_date filters), getVolatility.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Central API service layer built on axios. Provides typed REST API wrappers for all backend endpoints: market (instruments, subscribe, snapshots, kline, options, volatility, preset, exchanges, products, search), orders (insert, cancel, cancel_all, reverse, lock, stop orders), queries (positions, orders, trades, account), and connection status. Includes response interceptor for error handling and automatic timestamp conversion (seconds to milliseconds) for K-line data.

nodes.name: API_BASE
nodes.summary: API base URL constant, reads from VITE_API_BASE env var, defaults to 'http://localhost:8000'.

nodes.name: types
nodes.summary: Central type definitions file aligned with CTP data structures. Defines all domain interfaces: MarketSnapshot (50+ fields with 5-level bid/ask depth), KLineData, DepthData, VolatilityData, OrderRequest, OrderRecord (30+ CTP fields), StopOrderRequest/StopOrder, TradeRecord, PositionRecord, AccountInfo, ContractInfo, QuoteDepth, OptionContract/OptionQuote/OptionChain, WSMessage types, ApiResponse, HotKeyConfig, QuickTradeConfig, UserPreferences. All field names use camelCase convention.

nodes.name: MarketSnapshot
nodes.summary: Market depth snapshot interface with 50+ fields: instrumentID, lastPrice, 5-level bid/ask prices and volumes, volume, openInterest, OHLC, settlement/preClose/preSettlement prices, upper/lower limit prices, turnover, averagePrice, exchangeID, tradingDay, actionDay, updateTime, updateMillisec.

nodes.name: KLineData
nodes.summary: K-line candlestick data point: timestamp (ms), open, high, low, close, volume, openInterest.

nodes.name: ContractInfo
nodes.summary: Contract metadata: instrumentID, instrumentName, exchangeID, productID, volumeMultiple, priceTick, expireDate, isTrading (0/1), productClass ('1'=futures, '2'=options, '3'=combo).

nodes.name: OrderRecord
nodes.summary: Order record with 30+ CTP fields: orderRef, orderSysID, instrumentID, exchangeID, direction, combOffsetFlag, limitPrice, volumeTotalOriginal/Traded/Total, orderStatus, timeCondition, insertDate/Time, cancelTime, frontID, sessionID, stopPrice. OrderStatus is aliased to this type.

nodes.name: WSMessage
nodes.summary: Generic WebSocket message wrapper with type (WSMessageType union: market_data, order_return, trade_return, position_update, stop_order_update, connection_status, instruments_refreshed, ping, error) and generic data payload.

nodes.name: contracts.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite for contracts Zustand store. Tests initial empty state, setContracts, addContractInfo (adds to userContracts, dedup, persists to userPrefs), removeFromFavorites (removes from userContracts only, syncs userPrefs), removeContractById (removes from both preset and user, CTP unsubscribe), loadSubscribedContracts (loads preset + user from API, handles preset failure gracefully, skips API when no IDs).

nodes.name: useContractsStore
nodes.summary: Zustand store managing contract subscriptions. Maintains presetContracts (system-managed, loaded from backend), userContracts (user-favorited), presetIds, and combined contracts list. Operations: addContractInfo (user favorite, no CTP call), removeFromFavorites (user only), subscribeAndAddToPreset (CTP subscribe + add to preset + persist manualPresetIds), removeContractById (CTP unsubscribe + remove from both), loadSubscribedContracts (merges backend presets + manual presets + user selections, batch loads contract details). Uses useUserPrefsStore for localStorage persistence.

nodes.name: order
nodes.summary: FastAPI router for order management (PR-9/PR-13). Provides REST endpoints for submitting, canceling, querying orders; one-click reverse position (serial/parallel modes with SHFE today/yesterday split); lock position; and stop order CRUD. Uses Pydantic models for request validation with CTP-specific constraints (volume limits by product class and price type, FOK/FAK/GFD time-volume condition combos). Delegates to OrderManager for insert/cancel and StopService for stop orders.

nodes.name: InsertOrderRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for submitting a new CTP order. Fields: instrumentID, direction (buy/sell), offsetFlag (open/close/close-today), priceType (market/limit), limitPrice, stopPrice, volumeTotalOriginal, timeCondition (IOC/GFS/GFD), volumeCondition, hedgeFlag, productClass, exchangeID. Validates volume limits (market futures<=60/options<=30, limit futures<=500/options<=100) and time-volume condition combos (FOK=IOC+CV, FAK=IOC+AV).

nodes.name: CancelOrderRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for canceling an existing order. Fields: orderRef (required), orderSysID (optional).

nodes.name: ReverseOrderRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for one-click reverse position. Supports separate close/open price types and time conditions, with execution mode (serial=close then open, parallel=both simultaneously). Fields: instrumentID, closePriceType, closeLimitPrice, closeTimeCondition, openPriceType, openLimitPrice, openTimeCondition, executionMode.

nodes.name: LockOrderRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for one-click lock position (open opposite direction without closing existing). Fields: instrumentID, priceType, limitPrice, timeCondition.

nodes.name: SubmitStopOrderRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for submitting a stop order. Fields: instrumentID, exchangeID, direction, offsetFlag, limitPrice, volume, stopPrice (trigger price), triggerPriceType (market/limit after trigger).

nodes.name: CancelStopOrderRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for canceling a stop order. Field: stopOrderID (required).

nodes.name: insert_order
nodes.summary: POST /insert endpoint. Validates TD connection status and delegates to OrderManager.insert() with all order parameters from InsertOrderRequest.

nodes.name: cancel_order
nodes.summary: POST /cancel endpoint. Cancels an existing order by orderRef via OrderManager.cancel().

nodes.name: order_status
nodes.summary: GET /status/{order_ref} endpoint. Queries order status by orderRef via OrderManager.get_order(). Returns 404 if not found.

nodes.name: cancel_all_orders
nodes.summary: POST /cancel_all endpoint. Cancels all active orders via OrderManager.cancel_all().

nodes.name: reverse_position
nodes.summary: POST /reverse endpoint. One-click reverse: closes current position then opens opposite direction. Supports serial (close accepted then open) and parallel (both simultaneously) execution modes. Handles SHFE today/yesterday split. Uses market data snapshot for protection price in market-price mode.

nodes.name: lock_position
nodes.summary: POST /lock endpoint. One-click lock: opens opposite direction position without closing existing, for hedging risk.

nodes.name: submit_stop_order
nodes.summary: POST /stop endpoint. Creates a stop order that monitors market data and auto-submits when stop price is reached.

nodes.name: cancel_stop_order
nodes.summary: POST /stop/cancel endpoint. Cancels a pending stop order by stopOrderID.

nodes.name: list_stop_orders
nodes.summary: GET /stop/list endpoint. Lists all stop orders (pending, triggered, canceled) via StopService.list_orders().

nodes.name: _get_valid_positions
nodes.summary: Helper to get valid positions for an instrument. Checks TD connection and filters query_service.positions by instrumentID. Returns (positions_list, error_message) tuple.

nodes.name: _get_protection_price
nodes.summary: Helper to get market price protection price from snapshot. Fallback chain: lastPrice -> preClosePrice -> openPrice. Returns (price, error_message) tuple.

nodes.name: _volume_condition_for
nodes.summary: Maps time condition to volume condition: IOC->FOK('3'), GFD->any('1'). Used for CTP order parameter construction.

nodes.name: _build_close_order_params
nodes.summary: Builds close order parameter dict for OrderManager.insert(). Handles market vs limit price modes with appropriate stop_price/limit_price values.

nodes.name: _build_open_order_params
nodes.summary: Builds open order parameter dict for OrderManager.insert(). Handles market vs limit price modes with offset_flag='0' (open).

nodes.name: _execute_reverse_parallel
nodes.summary: Parallel reverse execution: submits close and open orders simultaneously. Handles SHFE today/yesterday position split (close today with offset='3', close yesterday with offset='1').

nodes.name: _execute_reverse_serial
nodes.summary: Serial reverse execution: submits close orders first, then open orders after close accepted. Tracks total close volume for open quantity. Handles SHFE today/yesterday split.

nodes.name: kline_service
nodes.summary: K-line aggregation service that accumulates real-time CTP ticks into multi-period OHLCV bars (1m/5m/15m/30m/1h). Thread-safe implementation with lock-protected state. Computes volume delta from CTP cumulative volume, handles cross-day resets, and archives completed bars on time-window boundaries. Bars accumulate only from server start (no historical data).

nodes.name: PERIOD_SECONDS
nodes.summary: Dict mapping K-line period names to seconds: 1m=60, 5m=300, 15m=900, 30m=1800, 1h=3600.

nodes.name: _parse_timestamp
nodes.summary: Parses CTP ActionDay (YYYYMMDD) + UpdateTime (HH:MM:SS) into UTC Unix timestamp. Handles UTC+8 (Beijing time) conversion. Falls back to today's date when ActionDay is empty, with cross-midnight correction (if computed time is >5min in the future, subtract 1 day). Returns 0 on parse error.

nodes.name: KLineService
nodes.summary: Real-time K-line aggregation service. Thread-safe (uses threading.Lock). Maintains per-instrument per-period current bars and archived bar lists. update_tick() processes a single tick across all periods, archiving completed bars on time-window boundaries. get_klines() returns archived + current bars for a given instrument/period/count. max_bars limits archived bar storage (default 500). Volume delta computed from CTP cumulative volume with first-tick-zero and negative-delta-as-zero handling.

nodes.name: update_tick
nodes.summary: Processes a single tick (camelCase dict with instrumentID, lastPrice, volume, openInterest, actionDay, updateTime) and updates current bar for each period. Archives completed bars when time-window boundary is crossed. Computes volume delta from cumulative CTP volume. Skips invalid data (empty instrument, price<=0, timestamp parse failure).

nodes.name: get_klines
nodes.summary: Returns recent K-line bars (archived + current) for an instrument/period, newest last. Truncates to count parameter. Returns empty list for invalid period.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears all state (bars, current bars, last_volume). Used for testing.

nodes.name: test_kline_service
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for KLineService with 8 test classes covering: timestamp parsing (UTC+8, empty action day, malformed input, invalid time), initialization (defaults, custom max_bars), tick processing (single tick, OHLC correctness, volume delta, first-tick-not-cumulative, cross-day reset, multiple instruments, skip empty/invalid), time window boundaries (1m/5m, same-window merge), multi-period (all periods updated, invalid period), count limit, max bars trimming, thread safety (concurrent update_tick), and reset.

nodes.name: TestParseTimestamp
nodes.summary: Tests for _parse_timestamp: normal parsing, UTC+8 offset verification (difference exactly 28800s from UTC), empty action_day fallback to today, malformed action_day (short string), and invalid time string returning 0.

nodes.name: TestKLineServiceInit
nodes.summary: Tests for KLineService construction: import check, default empty state, default max_bars=500, custom max_bars parameter.

nodes.name: TestUpdateTick
nodes.summary: Tests for core tick-to-bar aggregation: single tick creates bar, OHLC correctness (open=first, high=max, low=min, close=last), volume delta computation, first tick volume not cumulative, cross-day negative delta reset, multiple instruments isolation, skip empty instrumentID, skip invalid price (0 or negative).

nodes.name: TestTimeWindow
nodes.summary: Tests for bar archival on time-window boundaries: 1m boundary creates new bar, 5m boundary, same window merges ticks into single bar.

nodes.name: TestMultiPeriod
nodes.summary: Tests for multi-period behavior: all periods (1m/5m/15m/30m/1h) updated from single tick, invalid period returns empty list.

nodes.name: TestCountLimit
nodes.summary: Tests for get_klines count parameter: count limits returned bars, default count=100.

nodes.name: TestMaxBars
nodes.summary: Tests for archived bar trimming: max_bars=3 trims old archived bars, result includes archived + current within limit.

nodes.name: TestThreadSafety
nodes.summary: Tests concurrent update_tick calls from 4 threads (50 ticks each) to verify no state corruption or exceptions.

nodes.name: TestReset
nodes.summary: Tests that reset() clears all accumulated bar data, returning empty results.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root application component for the SimNow trading terminal. Renders the main layout with resizable panels: MarketPanel (top-left), OrderPanel (top-right), and QueryPanel (bottom). Includes a status bar with ConnectionStatus, settings gear button, and FPS monitor toggle (Ctrl+Shift+M). Manages panel size persistence via localStorage. Initializes system WebSocket and connection polling on mount.

nodes.name: OrderPanel.test
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the OrderPanel component. Tests rendering of panel title, tab switching between order form and stop order form, keyboard hotkeys (B/S keys for buy/sell direction), QuickActions buttons (one-click reverse, lock, batch cancel), and BatchCancel panel overlay. Mocks the order store and API service modules.

nodes.name: OrderPanel
nodes.summary: Order panel component providing trading order entry and management. Features tabbed interface switching between OrderForm (standard orders) and StopOrderForm (stop-loss orders). Integrates QuickActions for one-click reverse position, lock position, and batch cancel. Supports hotkeys (B=buy, S=sell, reverse, lock, batch cancel) via useHotKeys hook. Builds confirmation dialogs for reverse/lock operations using quickTradeConfig. Calculates counterparty prices with priceTick support. Renders BatchCancel overlay for unfilled orders and ConfirmDialog for trade confirmations.

nodes.name: QueryPanel.test
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the QueryPanel component. Tests rendering of panel title, all 6 tab buttons (orders, trades, positions, account, stop orders, contracts), default tab selection, tab switching, pause/resume toggle, refresh button, and correct sub-component rendering per active tab (OrderFlow, TradeFlow, Position, AccountQuery, StopOrderList). Mocks the API service module.

nodes.name: QueryPanel
nodes.summary: Query panel component providing tabbed access to trading data views. Supports 7 tabs: orders (OrderFlow), trades (TradeFlow), positions (Position), account (AccountQuery), stop orders (StopOrderList), contracts (ContractQuery), and K-line chart (KLineChart). Auto-refreshes data every 10 seconds when not paused. Fetches K-line historical data on instrument/period change with timestamp alignment. Supports 'C' key shortcut for cancel-all on orders tab. Manages pause/resume and manual refresh controls.

nodes.name: store.test
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the QueryStore (Zustand store). Tests tab switching, pause/resume toggle, fetch methods for orders/trades/positions/account/stop orders with API mocking, refreshAll with serial execution and skip-when-paused logic, order cancellation with optimistic updates using CTP status code '5', incremental order/trade upsert (insert new at top, update in-place), and highlight tracking (newOrderRefs, newTradeIDs) with clear methods.
imports: ../../services/api (mock: refreshOrders, refreshTrades, refreshPositions, refreshAccount, getStopOrders, cancelOrder, cancelAllOrders, cancelStopOrder)

nodes.name: useQueryStore
nodes.summary: Zustand store for query panel state management. Manages active tab selection, data for orders/trades/positions/account/stop orders, and new-data highlight tracking (newOrderRefs, newTradeIDs). Provides fetch methods that call CTP refresh APIs (serial execution with 1.2s delays to respect CTP rate limits and 10s per-query timeout). Supports incremental WebSocket updates via upsertOrder/upsertTrade. Includes cancel order/all/stop-order actions with optimistic updates. Defines TypeScript interfaces for raw CTP data (RawOrder, RawTrade, RawPosition) and QueryTab union type.
imports: ../../services/api (refreshOrders, refreshTrades, refreshPositions, refreshAccount, getStopOrders, cancelOrder, cancelAllOrders, cancelStopOrder)

nodes.name: useReconnect.test
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the useReconnect hook. Covers four scenarios: (1) no reconnect when connection is healthy, (2) reconnect after disconnect with exponential backoff, (3) exposing reconnect count and status from hook return value, (4) giving up after max retries (5 attempts with 1s/2s/4s/8s/16s backoff totaling 31s). Uses vitest fake timers and a mock WSManager factory.

layers.name: Frontend UI Components
layers.description: React presentational components for the trading terminal UI. Includes the root App layout, market data display panels (MarketPanel, MarketTable, KLineChart), order entry forms (OrderPanel, OrderForm, StopOrderForm), query views (QueryPanel), reusable UI widgets (ContractSearch, DepthQuote, SpreadDisplay), and technical indicator calculations (MA, EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands, KDJ, RSI).

layers.name: Frontend State Management
layers.description: Zustand stores managing client-side application state. Includes market data store (snapshots, K-line data, selected instruments), contract subscription store (preset/user contracts, subscribe/unsubscribe), query store (orders, trades, positions, account data with incremental WebSocket updates), order store (form state, submission), and user preferences store (hotkeys, quick trade config, localStorage persistence).

layers.name: Frontend Services
layers.description: Client-side service layer for backend communication. Includes the centralized REST API client (axios-based, covering market/order/query/options endpoints), WebSocket client manager (WSManager with reconnection), and shared TypeScript type definitions aligned with CTP data structures (MarketSnapshot, KLineData, ContractInfo, OrderRecord, WSMessage).

layers.name: Frontend Hooks
layers.description: Custom React hooks encapsulating complex stateful logic. Includes useMarketWs (WebSocket market data with 100ms batch merging, K-line conversion, night session handling), useReconnect (exponential backoff reconnection), useHotKeys (keyboard shortcut binding), and usePointOrder (click-to-order integration).

layers.name: Frontend Styles
layers.description: CSS stylesheets defining the dark trading terminal theme. Includes the global design system (CSS custom properties for colors, typography, layout), and module-specific styles for market panel (K-line chart, contract table), order panel (form, stepper, toggle buttons), and query panel (data tables, account grid, flow components).

layers.name: Backend API
layers.description: FastAPI router layer exposing REST endpoints. Includes the order router (insert, cancel, cancel-all, reverse position with serial/parallel modes, lock position, stop order CRUD) with Pydantic request validation models enforcing CTP-specific constraints (volume limits, time-volume condition combos). Helper functions handle position validation, protection price fallback, and reverse execution orchestration.

layers.name: Backend Services
layers.description: Business logic services implementing core trading terminal functionality. Includes KLineService (real-time K-line aggregation from CTP ticks into multi-period OHLCV bars with thread-safe accumulation), MarketService (contract management, market data snapshots, subscription tracking), OrderManager (order lifecycle with CTP integration, retry logic), QueryService (CTP query refresh with rate limiting), StopOrderService (price-triggered stop order monitoring), OptionsService (option chain calculation, volatility surface), and CTP bridge/startup (connection lifecycle, field mapping).

layers.name: Backend Models
layers.description: Pydantic data models defining the server-side data contracts. Includes MarketSnapshot (5-level bid/ask depth, OHLC, volume, timestamps), KLineData (candlestick bar with OHLCV), plus account, contract, order, and options models. All models use camelCase field names for frontend compatibility.

layers.name: Backend CTP Wrapper
layers.description: CTP protocol integration layer wrapping the ctp-python SWIG bindings. Includes MdUserApi (market data connection, login, subscribe/unsubscribe), TraderApi (trading connection, order insertion/cancellation, position/account queries), callback SPI (event-driven callback handling with BaseSpi pattern), and CTP type enums (Direction, OffsetFlag, OrderStatus). Handles the critical string-list requirement for SubscribeMarketData to avoid heap corruption.

layers.name: Backend WebSocket
layers.description: WebSocket server layer providing real-time data push to the frontend. Includes the WebSocket manager (connection lifecycle, client tracking, broadcast) and message handlers for each endpoint: /ws/market (market data snapshots), /ws/order (order returns, trade returns), /ws/position (position updates), /ws/stop (stop order updates), /ws/system (connection status, errors). Supports heartbeat ping/pong for connection health.

layers.name: Backend Infrastructure
layers.description: Server infrastructure and configuration. Includes FastAPI app setup (main.py with lifespan management, CORS, router mounting), environment configuration (config.py reading from .env for CTP connection details, broker credentials), CTP field mapping utilities (camelCase conversion, invalid price handling), reconnection logic, and server startup orchestration.

layers.name: Frontend Tests
layers.description: Vitest unit and integration tests for frontend modules. Covers component rendering (MarketPanel, KLineChart, OrderPanel, QueryPanel), Zustand store behavior (market, contracts, query, order, options stores), API service functions, WebSocket hooks (useMarketWs, useReconnect), utility functions (price calculation, formatting, validation), and UI interactions (hotkeys, tab switching, batch operations).

layers.name: Backend Tests
layers.description: Pytest test suites for server-side modules. Covers K-line service (timestamp parsing, tick-to-bar aggregation, multi-period, thread safety), CTP wrapper (callback SPI, field mapping, API lifecycle), REST API endpoints (market, order, query, options), WebSocket handlers (message routing, heartbeat), business services (market, order manager, query, stop order, options), data models, and integration tests.

layers.name: Documentation

tour.title: Frontend Entry Point
tour.description: Start here. main.tsx is the React entry point that mounts the App component into the DOM with StrictMode enabled. App.tsx defines the entire terminal layout using resizable panels: a top section split horizontally into Market (70%) and Order (30%), and a bottom Query panel. It also initializes the system WebSocket connection and connection polling on mount.

tour.title: REST API Client Layer
tour.description: The frontend communicates with the Python backend via a centralized API client built on axios. api.ts defines all REST endpoints organized by domain: market data (subscribe, snapshots, K-line, options), order management (insert, cancel, batch cancel, reverse, lock), query (positions, trades, account, contracts), and connection status. types.ts contains the shared TypeScript interfaces for all API payloads. Note how submitOrder() uses convertOrderRequest() to translate frontend form fields into CTP protocol format before sending.

tour.title: WebSocket Real-Time Layer
tour.description: Real-time data flows through five dedicated WebSocket endpoints (market, order, position, stop, system). The WSManager class manages all connections with automatic ping/pong heartbeat handling. Each endpoint has its own connect/disconnect lifecycle and message callback. The useSystemWs hook listens for connection status changes, while useMarketWs receives live market data ticks and updates the store. useReconnect handles automatic reconnection with exponential backoff.

tour.title: State Management (Zustand Stores)
tour.description: The app uses Zustand for lightweight state management. The connection store tracks MD (market data) and TD (trading) connection phases independently (disconnected/connecting/connected/error). The contracts store manages the full instrument list loaded from the backend. UserPrefs persists user preferences (hotkeys, quick trade settings) to localStorage. Each feature module (market, order, query, options) has its own dedicated store for domain-specific state.

tour.title: Market Module (K-Line, Depth, Table)
tour.description: The market module is the largest frontend feature. MarketTable uses @visactor/vtable for high-performance virtual scrolling of 1000+ instruments. KLineChart renders candlestick charts with ECharts, supporting multiple timeframes and technical indicators (MA, EMA, BOLL, MACD, RSI, KDJ, VOL). DepthQuote shows the 5-level bid/ask order book. The market store handles real-time snapshot updates and K-line bar aggregation with proper volume delta calculation to avoid inflated volume numbers from CTP cumulative values.

tour.title: Order Module (Order Form, Stop Orders)
tour.description: The order module handles trade execution. OrderForm provides the main order entry interface with instrument selection, direction (buy/sell), offset (open/close), price type (limit/market), and quantity. StopOrderForm implements conditional stop-loss orders that trigger when price crosses a threshold. The QuickActions component offers one-click reverse position and lock position features. BatchCancel allows cancelling all pending orders at once.

tour.title: Query Module (Positions, Trades, Account)
tour.description: The query module displays account information across multiple tabs. Position shows current holdings with P&L. OrderFlow and TradeFlow display order and trade history. AccountQuery shows balance, margin, and commission. ContractQuery allows browsing the full instrument database. StopOrderList shows active and triggered stop-loss orders. All panels support both cached reads and forced refreshes that trigger fresh CTP queries.

tour.title: Options Module (T-Quote, Option Chains)
tour.description: The options module provides options trading capabilities. OptionPanel displays option chain data in a T-quote format, showing calls and puts organized by strike price. It fetches data from the /api/market/option_chain endpoint and supports filtering by underlying instrument and expiration date. The volatility endpoint provides Black-Scholes implied volatility calculations.

tour.title: Shared UI Components
tour.description: Reusable components used across the application. ConnectionStatus shows the MD/TD connection state with visual indicators. ContractSearch and InstrumentSearchModal provide instrument lookup with exchange/product filtering. SettingsPanel contains hotkey and quick-trade configuration tabs. ResizeHandle enables draggable panel resizing. Toast provides notification popups. PerfMonitor displays real-time FPS metrics (Ctrl+Shift+M toggle). ErrorBoundary catches React rendering errors gracefully.

tour.title: Frontend Utilities
tour.description: Utility functions that support the frontend. format.ts handles number/date formatting for display. priceCalc.ts computes spread, tick-based price stepping, and limit price bounds. validators.ts validates order form inputs. panelStorage.ts persists panel sizes to localStorage. productNames.ts maps product codes to Chinese names. These utilities are thoroughly tested with accompanying .test.ts files.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point & Startup
tour.description: The Python backend starts via start.py, which auto-selects CTP addresses based on time of day (primary for weekday trading hours, secondary for extended hours), then launches uvicorn. main.py is the FastAPI application factory. It configures CORS for the frontend origin, registers four API routers (connection, market, order, query), sets up WebSocket endpoints, and initializes CTP connections (MD and TD) during the lifespan startup event. The MarketService, QueryService, StopOrderService, and OptionsService are attached to app.state.

tour.title: Backend API Routes
tour.description: Four FastAPI routers handle all REST endpoints. connection.py manages login/logout and status queries. market.py handles instrument listing, subscription, snapshots, K-line data, option chains, and volatility. order.py processes order insertion, cancellation, batch cancel, reverse position, lock position, and stop orders. query.py provides cached reads and forced refreshes for positions, trades, account balance, and contracts. Each router delegates to the appropriate service layer.

tour.title: Backend Services Layer
tour.description: The services layer contains the core business logic. market_service.py maintains an in-memory snapshot cache with thread-safe updates. kline_service.py aggregates tick data into OHLCV candle bars at multiple timeframes. order_manager.py tracks order state and coordinates with CTP. query_service.py caches CTP query results (positions, trades, account). stop_order.py monitors price triggers and auto-submits orders. options_service.py computes option chains and Black-Scholes volatility. reconnect.py handles automatic CTP reconnection.

tour.title: CTP Bridge & Field Mapping
tour.description: ctp_bridge.py is the critical glue between the CTP worker thread and the async web layer. It wires the OnRtnDepthMarketData callback so that each tick: (1) maps PascalCase CTP fields to camelCase dicts via field_mapping.py, (2) updates the MarketService snapshot cache, (3) broadcasts via WebSocket, (4) aggregates K-line bars, and (5) checks stop order triggers. field_mapping.py handles the CTP-to-camelCase field name translation that keeps the frontend type system aligned with CTP protocol.

tour.title: CTP Wrapper (Protocol Layer)
tour.description: The ctp_wrapper package wraps the ctp-python SWIG bindings. md_user_api.py manages the market data connection lifecycle (connect, login, subscribe, unsubscribe). trader_api.py manages the trading connection (connect, authenticate, login, confirm settlement, insert order, cancel order). callback.py implements the SPI callback pattern using composition (BaseSpi with event logging and handler registration). types.py defines CTP constant enums (Direction, OffsetFlag, OrderPriceType, etc.) as Python Enums mapped to CTP's char values.

tour.title: WebSocket Server Handlers
tour.description: The server-side WebSocket layer pushes real-time data to frontend clients. ws/manager.py maintains the set of connected WebSocket clients per endpoint and provides broadcast methods with heartbeat (ping/pong). ws/handlers.py defines the message routing logic for each endpoint type (market, order, position, stop, system). These handlers are invoked by the CTP bridge when new data arrives from the CTP worker thread, bridging the synchronous CTP callbacks to async WebSocket broadcasts.

tour.title: Data Models
tour.description: The models package defines Pydantic models for API request/response validation and internal data structures. market.py models market snapshots and K-line data. order.py models order requests, order state, and stop orders. account.py models account balance and position data. contract.py models instrument metadata. options.py models option chain and volatility data. These models ensure type safety between the API layer and the CTP data structures.

tour.title: Backend Test Suite
tour.description: The server/tests/ directory contains 108+ unit tests using pytest. conftest.py provides shared fixtures (mock CTP APIs, test clients). Tests cover every layer: config loading, CTP callback handling, field mapping, market/order/query API endpoints, service logic, WebSocket broadcasting, and options calculations. The test suite uses mocks extensively to avoid real CTP connections, making tests runnable outside trading hours.

tour.title: Configuration & Environment
tour.description: Configuration flows from .env files through config.py. The .env.sample template documents all available settings: CTP addresses (primary/secondary), BrokerID, UserID, password, and front addresses. start.py auto-selects primary vs secondary addresses based on time (weekday 09:00-16:00 uses primary/real trading, all other times uses secondary/extended hours). The frontend reads VITE_API_BASE from its own .env to locate the backend. Never commit .env with real credentials.
